All pairwise Condition comparisons

Source: R/report-helpers.R
condition_pairs.Rd

Replacement for the bare combn(conditions, 2) the report templates used to call: utils::combn() errors with n < m when a subset happens to contain a single Condition, which aborted the whole render. This returns an empty list in that case, so the calling section can print a note and move on.

Usage

condition_pairs(conditions, self = FALSE)

Arguments

conditions

Character vector or factor of condition names (factor levels are used, so the report's annotation order is preserved).

self

Include the self-comparisons (A vs A) appended after the pairs, as the overlap-matrix sections need. Default FALSE.

Value

A list of length-2 character vectors, named "<Cond1>_vs_<Cond2>"; empty (and, with self = TRUE, self-comparisons only) when fewer than two conditions are present.

Examples

condition_pairs(c("CTRL", "TREAT", "OTHER"))
#> $CTRL_vs_TREAT
#> [1] "CTRL"  "TREAT"
#> 
#> $CTRL_vs_OTHER
#> [1] "CTRL"  "OTHER"
#> 
#> $TREAT_vs_OTHER
#> [1] "TREAT" "OTHER"
#> 
condition_pairs("CTRL")                 # empty list, no error
#> list()
condition_pairs("CTRL", self = TRUE)    # just CTRL vs CTRL
#> $CTRL_vs_CTRL
#> [1] "CTRL" "CTRL"
#>
